title: Traditional Retractable Wall Hook | Autumn Sparkle | 2-1/2-Inch Extension | Brass Wall Mount | Allied Brass
description:
Need a place to hang towels and robes without a hook sticking out all the time? This traditional retractable wall hook extends when you need it, then pushes back in to sit close to the wall for a cleaner bathroom look in Autumn Sparkle, which captures the rich, warm tones of fall foliage with subtle shimmer, bringing seasonal warmth year-round.

Highlights:
- Autumn Sparkle transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Hang with confidence: supports up to 15 lb
- Match your existing hardware: remove the supplied knob tip and replace it with your own cabinet knob
- Designed for standard interior walls: installs with included toggle mounting hardware

Specs & Installation:
- Material: brass
- Mounting: wall mount
- Size: 3.75" W x 2" H x 2" L
- Projection: 1"
- Weight capacity: 15 lb
- Installation: drill a 3/4" diameter hole through drywall plus three small holes; includes 6/32 toggles and mounting hardware
available in multiple designer finish options including statement colors
